title: Straggler proxy: rollout wait p99 ÷ p50
description: Rollout-wait p99 divided by its median in each 30-minute bucket. A ratio near one means similar waits; a large ratio identifies unusually slow steps. This measures step-to-step spread across the run’s executions, and partial buckets use only observations inside the selected window. Run-wide: this panel ignores the Job and Execution pickers.
